## Structural variants

```{r sv-info}
# The table is built from the caller VCF, not from the annotation, so it survives a
# missing VEP SV VCF — an empty table here means no SV records were found at all.
if (is.null(sv_table) || nrow(sv_table) == 0) {
  section_notice("No somatic structural variants detected.")
}
```

```{r sv-bnd-circos}
# Breakend circos: the same rearrangements as the table below, drawn as arcs over just
# the chromosomes they touch. Inlined rather than embedded as a base64 <img> like the
# genome-wide circos, because the arcs have to be reachable from the page's own script —
# see R/circos_bnd.R.
bnd_res = NULL
if (!is.null(sv_table) && nrow(sv_table) > 0) {
  bnd_res = tryCatch({
    # One filtered set feeds both calls, so the gene track cannot label an arc that was
    # never drawn.
    bnd_drawn = bnd_links(sv_table, chromosomes)
    draw_bnd_circos(bnd_drawn,
                    bnd_panel_genes(bnd_drawn, params$all_panels),
                    cytobands, chrom_lens, chromosomes)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Breakend circos failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })
}

if (!is.null(bnd_res) && !is.null(bnd_res$svg)) {
  legend_item = function(swatch, var, label) {
    tags$div(class = "circos-legend__item",
             tags$span(class = paste0("circos-swatch--", swatch),
                       style = paste0("--_swatch: var(", var, ")")),
             label)
  }
  tagList(
    tags$p(class = "circos-eyebrow",
           sprintf("Breakends · %d chromosome%s · %s",
                   length(bnd_res$chroms),
                   if (length(bnd_res$chroms) == 1) "" else "s",
                   if (isTRUE(bnd_res$interactive))
                     "select a row below to highlight its arc"
                   else "row highlighting unavailable")),
    tags$div(class = "bnd-circos", HTML(bnd_res$svg)),
    tags$div(class = "circos-legend",
      tags$div(class = "circos-legend__group",
        tags$div(class = "circos-legend__title", "Breakend circos"),
        legend_item("arc", "--circos-bnd",          "Rearrangement"),
        legend_item("arc", "--circos-bnd-selected", "Selected in the table"),
        legend_item("bar", "--circos-bnd-gene",     "Panel gene")
      )
    ),
    tags$p(class = "bnd-circos-caption", tags$span(id = "bnd-shown-count")),
    # An untagged plot is still a useful figure, but it must not claim to highlight:
    # a mismatch means the arcs and the rows are no longer the same objects.
    if (!isTRUE(bnd_res$interactive))
      section_notice(paste("The arcs could not be matched to table rows, so selecting a",
                           "row will not highlight one. The plot itself is unaffected."))
  )
} else if (!is.null(bnd_res)) {
  section_notice(bnd_res$reason)
}
```

```{r sv-prepare, results='asis'}
# Column positions are published from R rather than scraped from the rendered header:
# see the panel-filter script in per_sample.qmd.
if (!is.null(sv_table) && nrow(sv_table) > 0) {
  sv_display = copy(sv_table)
  # Populated client-side by the panel filter, so switching panels updates it on the
  # existing redraw. The load-time panel's hits are already in sv_panel_hit (same
  # function, same windows) and drive the "Panel SVs" card.
  sv_display[, panel_hit := ""]
  setcolorder(sv_display, c("id", "panel_hit"))
  cat("<script>window.SV_COLS = ", js_col_index_map(names(sv_display)), ";</script>\n",
      sep = "")
}
```

```{r sv-table}
if (!is.null(sv_table) && nrow(sv_table) > 0) {
  idx0 = function(nm) which(names(sv_display) == nm) - 1L

  # A breakend annotated as truncating a whole span can carry a hundred-odd symbols.
  # Truncate the *display* only — sorting, searching and the CSV/copy buttons below
  # use the "sort" rendering, which returns the full list.
  gene_render = JS(
    "function(data, type) {",
    "  if (type !== 'display' || !data) return data;",
    "  const g = String(data).split(',');",
    "  if (g.length <= 6) return data;",
    "  return '<span title=\"' + String(data).replace(/\"/g, '') + '\">' +",
    "         g.slice(0, 6).join(',') + ' +' + (g.length - 6) + ' more</span>';",
    "}")

  # Same predicate as the row filter, so the column always agrees with what is shown.
  panel_hit_render = JS(
    "function(data, type, row) {",
    "  return window.svPanelHitLabel ? window.svPanelHitLabel(row, window.SV_COLS) : '';",
    "}")

  dtbl = DT::datatable(
    sv_display,
    rownames   = FALSE,
    filter     = "top",
    elementId  = "sv-table",
    # A static DT widget carries no selection config, and the binding then defaults
    # data.selection.mode to "none" and does no row selection at all
    # (DT/htmlwidgets/datatables.js:230). Saying so explicitly keeps that true if this
    # table ever gains a server/Shiny mode, so the breakend circos's own selection below
    # stays the only one and cannot end up fighting DT's `.selected` styling.
    selection  = "none",
    extensions = c("Buttons", "Scroller"),
    options    = list(
      dom       = "Bfrtip",
      buttons   = list(list(extend = "copy", exportOptions = list(orthogonal = "sort")),
                       list(extend = "csv",  exportOptions = list(orthogonal = "sort"))),
      scrollX   = TRUE,
      scrollY   = "350px",
      scroller  = TRUE,
      deferRender = TRUE,
      pageLength = 25,
      columnDefs = list(
        list(targets = idx0("panel_hit"), render = panel_hit_render),
        list(targets = c(idx0("gene_a"), idx0("gene_b")), render = gene_render)
      ),
      initComplete = JS("function() { window.svTableElem = this.api().table().node(); }")
    )
  ) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      columns = "svtype",
      target  = "cell",
      backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(
        c("DEL",     "DUP",     "INV",     "INS",     "BND",     "sBND"),
        c("#dbeafe", "#dcfce7", "#fef9c3", "#fee2e2", "#f3e8ff", "#f3e8ff")
      )
    )
  dtbl
}
```

```{r sv-bnd-circos-js, results='asis'}
# Cross-link the table to the circos. This owns the row selection outright — see the
# `selection` note above. Row identity comes from the DataTables API rather than from a
# DOM id, because Scroller plus deferRender recycle the <tr> nodes, which is also why the
# selected class is re-applied on every draw; the arcs are found by the data-svid R wrote
# onto them.
if (!is.null(bnd_res) && !is.null(bnd_res$svg)) {
  cat("<script>\n")
  cat("const BND_INTERACTIVE = ", if (isTRUE(bnd_res$interactive)) "true" else "false",
      ";\n", sep = "")
  cat(r"----(
(function () {
  // Quarto's HTML pipeline lowercases attribute names, so svglite's `viewBox` reaches
  // the page as `viewbox`. An HTML parser is meant to case-correct SVG attributes back
  // (the "adjust SVG attributes" table), but SVG attributes are case-sensitive once
  // parsed and a plain `viewbox` leaves the plot with no viewBox at all — which means
  // no aspect ratio, so `height: auto` cannot scale it. Repairing it here is a no-op
  // wherever the parser already did the right thing.
  document.querySelectorAll(".bnd-circos svg").forEach(function (el) {
    const vb = el.getAttribute("viewBox") || el.getAttribute("viewbox");
    if (vb && !el.getAttribute("viewBox")) el.setAttribute("viewBox", vb);
    // The intrinsic pt size fights `width: 100%`; the viewBox is the only size it needs.
    el.removeAttribute("width");
    el.removeAttribute("height");
  });

  if (!BND_INTERACTIVE) return;

  const SELECTED = new Set();
  // null until the first sync: everything drawn counts as visible.
  let visibleIds = null;
  let visibleGenes = new Set();

  const table = () => (window.svTableElem ? $(window.svTableElem).DataTable() : null);
  const all = (sel) => document.querySelectorAll(".bnd-circos " + sel);

  function rowId(row) {
    const cols = window.SV_COLS || {};
    return cols["id"] === undefined ? null : String(row[cols["id"]]);
  }

  // The panel genes a row hits, from the very predicate that fills its panel_hit cell —
  // so a gene is labelled on the plot exactly when it is named in the table. Labels
  // arrive as "MYC (A), BCL2 (B)".
  function rowGenes(row) {
    if (!window.svPanelHits) return [];
    return window.svPanelHits(row, window.SV_COLS)
      .map((lab) => lab.split(" (")[0])
      .join(",")
      .split(",")
      .map((g) => g.trim().toUpperCase())
      .filter((g) => g.length > 0);
  }

  function apply() {
    const liveChroms = new Set();
    all(".bnd-link").forEach(function (el) {
      const id = el.getAttribute("data-svid");
      const shown = visibleIds === null || visibleIds.has(id);
      const picked = SELECTED.has(id);
      el.classList.toggle("is-dim", !shown);
      el.classList.toggle("is-selected", picked);
      // SVG has no z-index: a highlighted arc is raised by being re-appended.
      if (picked) el.parentNode.appendChild(el);
      if (shown) {
        liveChroms.add(el.getAttribute("data-chrom-a"));
        liveChroms.add(el.getAttribute("data-chrom-b"));
      }
    });
    all(".bnd-chrom-label").forEach(function (el) {
      el.classList.toggle("is-dim", !liveChroms.has(el.getAttribute("data-chrom")));
    });
    [".bnd-gene-body", ".bnd-gene-label", ".bnd-gene-line"].forEach(function (sel) {
      all(sel).forEach(function (el) {
        const g = (el.getAttribute("data-gene") || "").toUpperCase();
        el.classList.toggle("is-hidden", !visibleGenes.has(g));
      });
    });
    caption();
  }

  function caption() {
    const el = document.getElementById("bnd-shown-count");
    if (!el) return;
    const total = all(".bnd-link").length;
    const shown = all(".bnd-link:not(.is-dim)").length;
    const genes = all(".bnd-gene-label:not(.is-hidden)").length;
    const parts = [shown + " of " + total + " arc" + (total === 1 ? "" : "s") + " shown"];
    if (genes > 0) parts.push(genes + " panel gene" + (genes === 1 ? "" : "s"));
    if (SELECTED.size > 0) parts.push(SELECTED.size + " selected");
    el.textContent = parts.join(" · ");
  }

  // Re-apply the selected class to the rows currently rendered. Scroller destroys and
  // rebuilds <tr> nodes, so this has to run on every draw, not just on click.
  function paintRows() {
    const t = table();
    if (!t) return;
    $(t.table().body()).find("tr").each(function () {
      const d = t.row(this).data();
      if (!d) return;
      const id = rowId(d);
      $(this).toggleClass("bnd-selected", id !== null && SELECTED.has(id));
    });
  }

  window.bndSyncFilter = function () {
    const t = table();
    if (!t) return;
    const ids = new Set();
    const genes = new Set();
    t.rows({ search: "applied" }).data().each(function (row) {
      const id = rowId(row);
      if (id !== null) ids.add(id);
      rowGenes(row).forEach((g) => genes.add(g));
    });
    visibleIds = ids;
    visibleGenes = genes;
    apply();
    paintRows();
  };

  $(document).on("click", "#sv-table tbody tr", function () {
    const t = table();
    if (!t) return;
    const d = t.row(this).data();
    if (!d) return;
    const id = rowId(d);
    if (id === null) return;
    if (SELECTED.has(id)) SELECTED.delete(id); else SELECTED.add(id);
    $(this).toggleClass("bnd-selected", SELECTED.has(id));
    apply();
  });

  // Covers the per-column search boxes too, which do not go through redraw().
  $(document).on("draw.dt", function (e) {
    if (e.target === window.svTableElem) window.bndSyncFilter();
  });
})();
)----")
  cat("\n</script>\n")
}
```

```{r sv-footnote}
# Provenance footnote, following the vaf_provenance() pattern in _smallvariants.qmd:
# say where the breakend symbols came from, and — because it is the difference between
# a filter that works on every sample and one that works on some — which panel matching
# mode is active, against which reference, with which windows.
if (!is.null(sv_table) && nrow(sv_table) > 0) {
  rel = function(p) {
    if (is.null(p)) return(NULL)
    root = sub("/+$", "", normalizePath(sample_dir, mustWork = FALSE))
    full = normalizePath(p, mustWork = FALSE)
    if (startsWith(full, paste0(root, "/"))) substring(full, nchar(root) + 2L) else p
  }

  # Built as one HTML string rather than a tagList: htmltools puts each child on its
  # own line, which HTML collapses to a space — leaving " ," after every <code>.
  code = function(x) paste0("<code>", htmltools::htmlEscape(x), "</code>")

  panel_note = if (is.null(panel)) {
    "No gene panel is applied on load; select one above to filter both tables."
  } else if (isTRUE(panel$has_coords)) {
    sprintf(paste("Panel %s matches on <strong>breakend coordinates</strong> (%s intervals,",
                  "within %s of either breakend of a BND or %s of the span of any other",
                  "type)%s"),
            code(basename(panel$path)), length(panel$start),
            fmt_bp(SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND), fmt_bp(SV_PANEL_WINDOW_OTHER),
            if (nzchar(panel$reference)) paste0(", built on ", panel$reference, ".")
            else paste(", whose reference is unverified — the panel declares none, so",
                       "nothing checks it against this report's."))
  } else {
    sprintf(paste("Panel %s carries no coordinates, so SVs are matched on <strong>gene",
                  "symbol</strong> only: a breakend VEP did not annotate cannot match,",
                  "whatever it is near. Add %s, %s and %s columns to match on position",
                  "instead."),
            code(basename(panel$path)), code("chrom"), code("start"), code("end"))
  }

  annot_note = if (!is.null(SECTION_DATA$sv$annotation_path))
    sprintf(paste("Breakend genes are from %s, joined on record ID; records that",
                  "annotation dropped (it keeps only FILTER PASS) have none."),
            code(rel(SECTION_DATA$sv$annotation_path)))
  else
    "No SV annotation file was found, so the breakend gene columns are empty."

  # What the circos above is showing, said once, next to the numbers it shares with the
  # table. Only mentioned when there is a plot to explain.
  circos_note = if (!is.null(bnd_res) && !is.null(bnd_res$svg))
    sprintf(paste("The circos above draws one arc per breakend with both loci mapped,",
                  "over the %d chromosome%s they touch. Gene bodies are the panel genes",
                  "within %s of a breakend — the same test that fills the %s column, so",
                  "a gene is drawn exactly when a visible row names it, and a panel",
                  "carrying no coordinates draws none. Bodies are markers at a minimum",
                  "visible width, not spans to scale."),
            length(bnd_res$chroms), if (length(bnd_res$chroms) == 1) "" else "s",
            fmt_bp(SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND), code("panel_hit"))
  else NULL

  tags$p(
    class = "table-footnote",
    HTML(paste(
      sprintf("%s rearrangement%s, one row each — Severus writes both sides of a breakend as two records, and mate pairs are collapsed here%s.",
              nrow(sv_table), if (nrow(sv_table) == 1) "" else "s",
              if (!is.na(n_trans) && !is.na(n_intra_bnd))
                sprintf(" (%s interchromosomal, %s intra-chromosomal breakend%s)",
                        n_trans, n_intra_bnd, if (n_intra_bnd == 1) "" else "s")
              else ""),
      annot_note, panel_note, circos_note))
  )
}
```
